text: たすけに　きて　くれた　きみに　この　ポケモンを　わたそう！

structure.jp: たすけに　きて　くれた　きみに
structure.en: to you, who came to rescue me

structure.jp: この　ポケモンを　わたそう！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たすけに　きて　くれた　きみ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits right before a noun and tells you more about that person. たすけに　きて　くれた　きみ = 'you, who came to rescue me'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending on a verb says 'I'll do it' or 'let's do it', a decision made on the spot. わたそう = 'I'll hand it over'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after the stem of a verb, followed by a verb of coming or going, tells what you come or go to do. たすけに　きて = 'come to rescue'.
